architectureRules: Immich is the only Media P0 asset-library authority for photo/video identity, metadata, people, albums and search.
ComfyUI is the only Media P0 generation/editing/workflow execution authority.
electron/mediaBrainRuntime.js is a thin adapter/coordinator only: no durable asset database, search index, embeddings, person/face model, image executor or custom scheduler.
Existing electron credential custody remains the only owner of Immich secrets; Media must not create another credential store.
Existing backend /api/r32/messages/:platform/:accountId/send-media-stream and existing business-command/sendQueue path remain the only send authority.
Existing backend/services/mediaPipeline.js remains transport/cache staging only and must not become a library/search authority.
Existing mediaIntelligenceService remains outside Media library authority; Media P0 must not use it to build a photo/video catalog, search index or person/face system.
No new npm dependency is authorized. Use runtime/platform capabilities already present.
External/non-loopback Immich or ComfyUI endpoints require explicit user configuration; loopback/local is the default privacy posture.
Generated/edited ComfyUI outputs must be imported back into Immich before becoming selectable Media assets.
Visible Media UI must expose upstream health, missing-model/degraded state, import, search/select, generate/edit, preview, save-back and send actions; controls must call real IPC/runtime actions.
No YancePhotoManager, YanceImageWorkflow, YanceImageGenerationEngine or equivalent second framework may be introduced.
retirementRules: Do not extend mediaPipeline into a persistent asset manager; treat it only as message transport/cache staging.
Do not extend mediaIntelligenceService into library analysis/search/person authority.
Do not persist a parallel Yance photo/video catalog for Immich assets; renderer state is transient projection only.
Do not implement custom image inference, model loading, node execution, prompt queueing or image-edit graph execution outside ComfyUI.
